Theorem
[Interior gradient estimate for general equations] 1. ch13:13.6\group ch13-holder-gradient Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0340 Let $u\in C^2(\Omega )$ solve (13.1). Assume $Q$ is elliptic, $a^{ij}\in C^1(\Omega \times \R \times \R ^n)$, and $b\in C^0(\Omega \times \R \times \R ^n)$. For every $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $, \begin{equation} [Du]_{\alpha ;\Omega '}\le Cd^{-\alpha }, \tag {13.31} \end{equation} where $K=|u|_{1;\Omega }$, $d=\operatorname {dist}(\Omega ',\partial \Omega )$, \[ C=C(n,K,\mu _K/\lambda _K,\operatorname {diam}\Omega ), \qquad \alpha =\alpha (n,K,\mu _K/\lambda _K)>0. \]
Proof

\sketch The reduction (13.15)–(13.27) and the iteration lemma give (13.30) on every interior ball. A covering at scale $d$ gives (13.31).

□
